💥 Cine Chaska Box Office Alert! Ranbir Kapoor और Yash की फिल्म Ramayana ने सिनेमाघरों में ऐसा गदर मचाया है कि बड़े-बड़े रिकॉर्ड्स ध्वस्त हो गए हैं!

5 November को रिलीज हुई director Nitesh Tiwari की इस फिल्म ने पहले ही दिन India में ₹64.85 crore का कलेक्शन करके चौथा सबसे बड़ा opening record बनाया था। Dussehra पर शुरू हुई advance booking में ही फिल्म ने worldwide ₹200 crore की टिकटें बेच ली थीं।

Sacnilk के ताज़ा अपडेट के मुताबिक, दूसरे weekend पर ₹61.25 crore के धमाकेदार उछाल के साथ फिल्म की कुल कमाई ₹673.95 crore तक पहुँच गई है। इसी के साथ Ramayana ने Shah Rukh Khan की Jawan (₹643.87 crore) और Stree 2 (₹625.27 crore) के lifetime hauls को पछाड़ दिया है, जबकि Pathaan और Animal को यह पहले ही पीछे छोड़ चुकी थी।

Namit Malhotra और Yash द्वारा प्रोड्यूस इस फिल्म में Sai Pallavi (Sita) और Sunny Deol (Lord Hanuman) भी हैं। PIB की प्रेस रिलीज़ के मुताबिक, Ramayana Part 1 को 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) के BRICS सेगमेंट की opening film चुना गया है।

क्या आपने सिनेमाघरों में Ranbir Kapoor की यह ग्रैंड फिल्म देख ली है? कमेंट्स में हमें अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana box office collection day 10: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer crosses  ₹670 crore, beats Stree 2, Jawan lifetime hauls
ctx.summary: The film stars Sai Pallavi as Sita and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It released in theatres on November 5.
ctx.text:
Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana , starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi, released in theatres on November 5. The film did great business on its opening day, setting a new record for a pre-Diwali release in India. However, the collections hit a dip on the second day, given it was a non-holiday and right before the weekend. It picked up with great speed on Monday and Tuesday, over the extended Diwali holiday period.
Advance bookings for Ramayana Part 1 opened on Dussehra, 15 days before release. By the time of its release, the film had already sold tickets worth ₹ 200 crore worldwide. The film went on to collect ₹ 64.85 crore in India on its first day of release, becoming the fourth-highest opening in Bollywood history. Ramayana entered the elite 500-crore club on Wednesday.
As per the latest update from Sacnilk, Ramayana collected ₹ 61.25 crore. It is a huge jump from the last few days' haul, taking full advantage of the second weekend at the box office. This brings the total collection to ₹ 673.95 crore so far. Ramayana has now surpassed the lifetime hauls of Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan (which stood at ₹ 643.87 crore) and Rajkummar Rao's Stree 2 (which stood at ₹ 625.27 crore). Earlier, the film had crossed the lifetime haul of Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan and Ranbir Kapoor's previous release, Animal.
Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu and his battle against the asura king Ravana after the latter abducts his wife, Sita.
Produced by Namit Malhotra ’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first released worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.
Ramayana Part 1 will be the opening film of the BRICS segment at the 57th edition of the International Film Festival of India, which will showcase films from all 11 member countries, along with contributions from partner countries, offering audiences an opportunity to explore diverse cinematic traditions and storytelling from across the BRICS nations, as per the press release shared by Press Infomation Bureau of India.
